designSystemScope: Separate Figma design-system board for a consultant service homepage template with advisory cards, proof ledgers, inquiry modules, testimonials, responsive notes, and editable placeholder guidance.
components: image placeholder and profile photo placeholder modules

states.default: teal primary action on light surface
states.hover: dark ink hover state for high-confidence advisory actions
states.focus: amber focus state for keyboard-visible controls
states.active: teal active state for selected modules

componentAnatomy.card: media slot, title, metadata, proof copy, CTA or status label
componentAnatomy.navigation: brand mark, link group, diagnostic call CTA
componentAnatomy.header: editable nav source row with brand and CTA
componentAnatomy.footer: brand, service links, company links, source notes
componentAnatomy.cta: inquiry form with editable labels and fields
componentAnatomy.placeholder: role-specific image and profile replacement clues

usageRules: Keep advisory proof close to service explanation, not only near the footer.
Use teal for action and evidence, amber only for focus or ordered steps.
Replace placeholders with consultant, workshop, boardroom, chart, or case-study images.

surfaceEffectTokens.cardShadow: soft cool shadow for advisory cards
surfaceEffectTokens.borderStroke: cool mist border on white surfaces

placeholderRules: Use image placeholder: [purpose] for case, boardroom, workshop, and chart visuals.
Use profile photo placeholder: [role] for consultant and advisor portraits.
Do not bake final generated imagery into the editable source template.
